chapter_seo_title: Li Huowang Buys Poisons, Fights a Dark Thought – Dao-Twisted World Chapter 55
chapter_meta_description: With silver running out and a motley crew to feed, Li Huowang equips his followers with rusty blades and cheap poisons. But his quietest battle is against a violent new thought that feels all too natural.
og_title: The Real Monster Is the Ledger: Chapter 55 of Dao-Twisted World
og_description: Haggling for poison, worrying about a simpleton's noodle bill, and catching himself seriously considering armed robbery—Li Huowang's post-temple life is a grind of mundane, soul-shaping horror.
twitter_title: Li Huowang's worst enemy this chapter is his own practical mind.
twitter_description: He buys poisons, sharpens rusty swords, and then calmly contemplates robbing the nice old man who helped him. The horror is in the pause before the guilt.
